| DW-B16-02 | **BUG: TightenOneStop() cancel+replace kills native ATM bracket and trail.** `CopyEngine.cs TightenOneStop()` does `acc.Cancel() + acc.CreateOrder("PTT-Tighten-Stop")` when it detects a `StopMarket` order via the `IsTrailingStop()` proxy. This kills the NT8 trail watermark and orphans the ATM bracket target order. Fix: remove cancel+replace branch; use `acc.Change()` for all stop types — same pattern as `MoveStopToBreakEven()` (GAP-001d CONFIRMED: acc.Change does NOT kill the trail). Also rename `"~"` button to clearly communicate one-shot stop tighten, not trail. Files: `CopyEngine.cs` (TightenOneStop), `TradeCopierPanel.cs` (button label in BuildUI). | P1 | Identified in Director review session 2026-07-14 |
